executive_assessment.text: Hurricane Beryl damaged Grenada's economy and infrastructure in 2024; recovery increased fiscal pressures.
Unsustainable agriculture, settlement expansion, forest loss and climate change jointly pressure Grenada's productive landscapes.
Grenada's2026 financing programme combined contingent disaster liquidity with water, infrastructure and social-safety-net reforms.
